Westwood Elementary's 4th-graders see 94.5% participation rate for 2024-25 MCA reading assessment
G. M. Kenyon
The Minnesota Department of Education noted that Westwood Elementary fourth-graders achieved the third highest participation in the reading component of the 2024-25 MCA assessments.
At Westwood Elementary, 69 out of 203 students completing this portion of the exam were in the fourth grade.
MCA test results indicated that 42% of these fourth-graders met the reading proficiency standards.
The MCA and the Alternate Minnesota Comprehensive Assessment (Alt MCA) serve as statewide tests to track student progress on Minnesota’s academic standards and fulfill legislative accountability. Assessment subjects include math, reading, and science, with grade level determining what is tested. Most students take the MCA; those in special education who qualify may take the Alt MCA.
According to Minnesota's Report Card, overall student proficiency on the state MCA tests fell compared to pre-pandemic data, with math proficiency showing a more than 7% decrease from 2019 and reading proficiency declining nearly 5%.
| Grade | # of Students Tested | Proficiency in reading |
|---|---|---|
| 3rd | 70 | 40% |
| 4th | 69 | 42% |
| 5th | 64 | 42% |
Details for this article come from the Minnesota Department of Education. The main dataset is available here.
